quests.title: An Actor... In the Aquarium?

dialogue.t: ...Alright, that was great! Let's just do one more take.
Furina! Oh, plus Columbina and Chiori too! You're still here?
Mmhmm! We just wrapped up filming our B-roll.
Ohh! You mean the fishie acting stuff you were doing? How did it all go?
Thanks to your help, we found a suitable actor for the role. The shoot went very smoothly!
You two have a real talent for this whole aquarium thing. Furina was just telling us how you've even inspired her to shoot an underwater documentary.

dialogue.sit: We're so happy you like it!

dialogue.t: I like it too. I can sense how content the little fish are, swimming around. You've done a great job taking care of their needs.
I just wish this aquarium could stay here forever. That way, I'd be able to come and visit whenever I wanted.
If you're going to miss it so much, why not add a few more scenic shots to the film?
You're right. We should totally shoot some more!
Some more shots! Come on now, lights, kamera... Where's my script supervisor? Everyone, take your positions!
Paimon's ready! But calling out takes for fish actors is... definitely a new experience, that's for sure.

quests.description: Your friends seem to be admiring the aquarium…
